milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate/observe' task — the player must navigate around the cobblestone structure (at spawn-relative ~3-7, 0, 4-8) to discover the hidden yellow glazed terracotta behind it. max_distance=5 ensures the player has genuinely navigated past the building (~13 blocks from spawn) rather than just turning to face it from the start. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the terracotta when nearby, modeling 'the player can see the target.'
